docTypes.question: Extract all invoice fields: vendor name, vendor tax id, vendor address (street, postal code, city, country), vendor email and phone, document number, invoice date, line items (description, quantity, unit price). Return strict JSON.

name.description: Name of the issuer, as printed. Null if not printed.

tax_id_raw.description: Tax identifier of the ISSUER only, exactly as printed (keep prefix, letters, digits; do not reformat). Null if not printed.

tax_id_label.description: The exact label text printed with the id (e.g. 'NIF', 'CIF', 'VAT ID', 'CUIT'). Null if none.

tax_id_type.description: Kind of the issuer's tax identifier, as best as can be told from its format and label. Informational only. Null if there is no id.

issuer.description: The party that issued the invoice (seller/supplier): usually the letterhead, logo or sender block. NOT the customer.

name.description: Name of the receiver, as printed. Null if not printed.

tax_id_raw.description: Tax identifier of the RECEIVER only, exactly as printed (keep any country prefix, letters and digits; do not reformat, do not invent). It may appear far from the receiver's name, for example in a table row like 'Cliente | NIF'; use any label or row that is explicitly attached to the customer. NEVER copy the issuer's tax id here. If the only id printed for the receiver is a personal id (DNI, passport, SSN) set tax_id_type='personal_id'. If no receiver tax id is printed, return null; do not guess.

tax_id_label.description: The exact label text printed with the id (e.g. 'NIF', 'CIF', 'VAT ID', 'CUIT'). Null if none.

tax_id_type.description: Kind of the receiver's tax identifier, as best as can be told from its format and label. Informational only. Null if there is no id.

receiver.description: The party being invoiced: the buyer/customer who owes payment (labels such as Bill to, Sold to, Customer, Cliente, Client, Destinatario, Kunde, Rechnungsempfänger). It is NOT the issuer/seller (the party that emits the invoice, usually with the logo or letterhead) and NOT the Ship to / delivery address, unless Ship to is the only buyer shown. Labels may be absent: infer roles from document structure (issuer = letterhead / sender block; receiver = the other party block). Return null if the receiver is not identifiable.

vendor_address.description: Street address of the party issuing the invoice (the supplier): street name and number only. Exclude postal code, city and country. Null if not printed.

vendor_postal_code.description: Postal code of the issuing party address, exactly as printed. Null if not printed.

vendor_city.description: City or town of the issuing party address. Null if not printed.

vendor_country.description: Country of the issuing party address, as printed (e.g. 'España'). Null if not printed — do not infer it from the currency or language.

vendor_email.description: Email address of the issuing party. Null if not printed.

vendor_phone.description: Telephone number of the issuing party. Null if not printed.

line_items.description: Line items, in the order they appear on the document. Empty array if none.

tax_rate.description: Numeric tax percentage on this line if printed (e.g., 21.0 for '21%' or 'IVA 21%'). Null if only a textual label is shown or no tax info is present.
